title: Catholic Academic Exchange Service (KAAD): Eastern Europe Programme
summary: KAAD scholarship for graduates, master's and doctoral candidates from Central, Eastern and South-east Europe, the Caucasus and Central Asia to study or research in Germany.

degree_levels.notes: Eligible for post-graduates with a Bachelor's degree for Master's programmes, young scientists for doctoral degrees, post-graduates for research stays / non-consecutive graduate or additional courses / medical training, and Master's students for a study stay (up to 6 months). Postdoctoral researchers and faculty are also mentioned in target groups, but student/doctoral tracks are in scope.

subject_areas.notes: Any subject area with the exception of courses of study in theology.

country_groups: Central, Eastern and South-east Europe, the Caucasus and Central Asia
nationality.notes: Explicitly listed countries on page: Albania, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Estonia, Georgia, Hungary, Kazakhstan, Kosovo, Kyrgyzstan, Latvia, Lithuania, Moldova, Republic of, North Macedonia, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Ukraine, Uzbekistan.

residence.notes: Applicants are from Central, Eastern and South-east Europe, the Caucasus and Central Asia, and country is the country in which you are living and from which you are applying.

mandatory.text: Applicants are expected to show excellent promise in their studies and/or research work.
Applicants must be socially engaged and involved in the Church and be ready to participate in inter-religious dialogue.
Proficiency in German at level B1 (or, for English-language courses of study at level A2).
Applicants are of catholic faith (in exceptional cases candidates may have differing denominations if recommended by catholic partner organisations).

exceptions.text: In exceptional cases candidates may have differing denominations, if they are recommended by catholic partner organisations.
Tuition fees for fee-based Master's programmes can be funded in exceptional cases.

funding.description: Not specified in numerical detail on the page.
funding.duration: Master's programme max. 24 months; doctoral degree max. 36 months; research stay up to 12 months; university teachers research stay up to 6 months; Master's study stay up to 6 months.

application_rounds.notes: Two-stage application procedure. Initial application can be submitted throughout the year. Second stage deadline is 15 January. Extracted deadline was '01-15'; year not confirmed.
Two-stage application procedure. Initial application can be submitted throughout the year. Second stage deadline is 30 June. Extracted deadline was '06-30'; year not confirmed.

recurring_deadline_notes: The initial application can be submitted throughout the year. Second-stage application deadlines are 15 January and 30 June of each year.

steps.text: Complete the online questionnaire to start the application process.
If selected for the second stage, necessary application documents will be sent.

sources.title: Catholic Academic Exchange Service (KAAD): Eastern Europe Programme - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: Provides student, master's, and doctoral funding for individuals from Central, Eastern and South-east Europe, the Caucasus and Central Asia to conduct study or research stays physically in Germany.
